reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted it in #central-random on Oct 13 at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could already see it.
- **One assumption:** Tobias didn't name the account. He called it his "dealer account". A public Central team summary from January says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. That's how I linked #8841 to Marrow Fieldworks. The summary doesn't actually say who took it over. I said this was my reading in the reply and asked Tobias to correct me if I have the wrong account.

I only used #central-random, #central-team and public files, all of which Pree can see. Ticket numbers are operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.
